# Device facts: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-3.49

The "B" listing is the same board in Case B with a Li-Po battery. Values marked *(assumed)* are stand-ins until they're measured on the board: the emulator uses them, but don't treat them as design limits.

## Screen

| Fact | Value |
|---|---|
| Drawing area (landscape) | 640 × 172 px |
| Physical size | about 86 × 23 mm, 190 ppi, **7.5 px per mm** |
| Colour | RGB565 (65,536 colours): gradients band, and colours are quantised before contrast is checked |
| Refresh | Full-frame only: every change redraws the whole screen. One frame takes 13 ms, so animation and kinetic scrolling judder. |
| Case | Case B, 98.5 × 34.8 × 22.8 mm |
| Rotation | The panel is portrait 172 × 640 with no hardware rotation; the kit rotates in software. Draw in landscape only. |

## Touch

| Fact | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | capacitive, **1 point only** (no pinch, no multi-touch) |
| Sampling | every 30 ms, only while the backlight is on |
| Wake | Touch **never** wakes the device. Only a button press wakes it. |

## Buttons

| Button | Notes |
|---|---|
| BOOT | Active low. Held through a reset, BOOT enters the ROM download mode, so never design a boot-time BOOT combination. |
| PWR | Active low. |

There are only two buttons. A short press steps, a hold commits, and both together make a chord; see `design-guide.md`.

## Power and battery

| Fact | Value |
|---|---|
| Power hold | On battery the board stays on only while P6 is asserted; releasing it powers the board off. |
| Battery | Li-Po 3.7 V. Percentage comes from a discharge curve *(assumed: generic Li-Po)*. |
| Power states | `active`, `display_off`, `light_sleep`, `off`, `download` |

## Audio, clock and radio

| Fact | Value |
|---|---|
| Audio | ES8311 codec driving a small speaker: tones only in the SDK (frequency, duration, volume) |
| Clock | PCF85063 real-time clock (UTC) |
| Wi-Fi | 2.4 GHz only. The ESP32-S3 has no 5 GHz radio. A phone hotspot must offer 2.4 GHz (iPhone: Maximize Compatibility). |
| Memory | 8 MB PSRAM, 16 MB flash |

## Design rules (checked by `ui_lint`)

| Rule | Severity | Threshold | Why | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `touch-target` | error | 56 px | 56 px is about 7.5 mm at 7.5 px/mm; smaller targets are missed by fingers. | Make the clickable object at least 56 x 56 px, or extend its click area; tag dense list rows "list-row". Exempt tags: `list-row`. |
| `font-min` | error | 12 px | 12 px text is about 1.6 mm tall on this panel; smaller is unreadable at arm's length. | Use a font with a line height of at least 12 px. |
| `contrast` | error | 4.5:1 | WCAG AA for normal text; small screens are read at a glance, often outdoors. | Darken the background or lighten the text until the ratio is at least 4.5:1 (checked on RGB565-quantised colours). |
| `clipped-text` | error | — | Text that doesn't fit is cut off or runs outside its object. | Shorten the text, widen the object, or set a long mode (wrap, dots, or scroll). |
| `missing-glyph` | error | — | Characters missing from the font render as nothing or as boxes. | Use a font that contains every character shown, or replace the characters. |
| `off-screen` | error | — | Objects outside 640 x 172 are invisible on the device. | Move or resize the object to fit inside the screen. |
| `overlap` | error | — | Overlapping click areas make a tap ambiguous. | Separate the clickable objects so their click areas don't intersect. |
| `no-momentum` | error | — | Every frame is a full-frame flush, so kinetic scrolling judders. | Clear LV_OBJ_FLAG_SCROLL_MOMENTUM; page or step instead. |
| `gradient` | warning | — | Gradients band visibly in RGB565. | Use flat colours, or a gradient between close colours. |

Tag an object with `lcd349_ui_tag(obj, "ignore:<rule-id>")` only when the exception is deliberate; the tag is visible in review.
